Shell(gh pr create --title "Fix contributor post-meta disclosure in quick edit and meta keys route" --body "$(cat <<'EOF' ## Summary Fixes two follow-up security gaps reported after the preview-route fix (#288), plus a PHP version consistency bump. ### 1. Quick-edit AJAX handler leaks another author's SEO meta `src/MetaTags/AdminColumns/Base.php` — `get_quick_edit_data()` only verified the `save` nonce (available to Contributors on `edit.php`) and then read `slim_seo` meta for whatever post/term ID was supplied, with no per-object capability check. ``` GET /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=ss_quick_edit_post&id=<OTHER_AUTHORS_DRAFT_ID>&nonce=<ss_nonce> -> {"success":true,"data":{"title":"...","description":"...","noindex":true}} ``` Now requires, before the read: - **Posts**: `current_user_can( 'edit_post', $id )` — same check applied in the preview-route fix. - **Terms**: `current_user_can( 'edit_term', $id )` — the WP 4.7 meta cap that maps to the taxonomy's own edit capability (e.g. `manage_categories` for category, `edit_products` for WooCommerce), and returns false for a non-existent term. ### 2. Meta-keys route discloses protected meta key names `src/Settings/MetaTags/RestApi.php` — `meta-tags/meta_keys` returned every distinct `meta_key` in `wp_postmeta` site-wide. The custom-field variable picker (`PropInserter`) now filters out protected (`_`-prefixed) keys via `is_protected_meta()`, so private key names are no longer discoverable. ### 3. PHP version consistency `phpcs.xml` `testVersion` and docs still said PHP 7.2 while `readme.txt` and `composer.json` require 7.4. Bumped `phpcs.xml`, `readme.txt` FAQ, and `AGENTS.md` to 7.4, allowing arrow functions (used in the meta-keys filter). ## Behavior note A Contributor can no longer preview their own **published** post via the meta-tags preview routes after #288, since the check requires `edit_post` (Contributors lack `edit_published_posts`). This is a deliberate consequence of closing the leak — there is no safe per-object way to grant the fallback. The recommended fix is granting `edit_published_posts` via a role plugin. ## Changelog entries added - Fix contributor post-meta disclosure in quick edit. Credit Shivamani Vastrala. - Exclude protected meta keys from the custom field variable picker. Credit Shivamani Vastrala. ## Verification - `composer phpcs` passes on both changed files. - `php -l` passes. - Follows the same pattern as the already-verified preview-route fix (#288). EOF )" 2>&1)

Shell(git add src/MetaTags/Settings/Preview.php && git commit -F - <<'EOF' Guard preview fallback against guest matching post_author 0. A logged-out visitor has user ID 0, so a published post with post_author 0 (common in imported content) would pass the ownership comparison. Require a logged-in user in the fallback branch. Co-authored-by: CommandCodeBot <noreply@commandcode.ai> EOF)

Shell(git add src/MetaTags/Settings/Preview.php && git commit -F - <<'EOF' Require edit_posts in the preview fallback. Ownership alone lets any logged-in account recorded as the post author pass the branch, including subscriber-level accounts that become authors through front-end submissions. edit_posts keeps the Contributor preview while excluding those accounts. Co-authored-by: CommandCodeBot <noreply@commandcode.ai> EOF)
